selection: full: all Train; recent/spread: Stage12 mid843, fixed default seed42. Recent descending gas-Batch fill; spread capacity-capped round-robin. No ranking of models/seeds by past or current scores.
confounding: recent versus spread has matched 843 rows and gas counts. full versus subset also changes sample amount/class proportions/balanced penalties and fitted preprocessing; cannot attribute solely to temporal composition.
exclusion: Only identical ordered Train hashes removed before validation; otherwise no removal based on prediction or correctness. Degenerate identical predictions reported.
baseline: full expert in same Fold; no ModelB trained through7 in Validation7
hard: Equal one vote per included expert. Tie: full predicted class if tied, else lowest gas id.
rank: Validate SVC OVR n×6 finite scores/classes1..6. Per expert descending stable rank -> points5..0; sum equally. Tie: full expert class rank, then lowest gas id. Never average raw scores/probabilities. Rank candidate skipped if any mapping/score audit fails.
oracle: If any expert predicts true label, return truth; otherwise full prediction. Accuracy/Recall selection upper bound, MacroF1 fixed-fallback diagnostic not globally optimized F1 bound. Never usable as deployed prediction or combination tuning.

gate.focus: For Tol or Ac: mean_Fold oracleRecall minus maximum single-expert mean_Fold Recall>=.02 AND sum_Fold(any_correct & full_wrong & true_gas)>=10
gate.provenance: every expert past-only and imputer/scaler/support-vector audit passes

aggregation: equal Fold means; per-gas means only positive-support Folds; other-four F1 equal gas/Fold means for1,2,3,5; missing truth metrics NA not zero; pooled metrics separately labelled; Fold SD descriptive only
reuse: Match source sha, reconstructed Stage12/14 ordered rows, feature values/raw sha, median/scaler/class weights/support vectors; reloaded predictions match old records. If provenance audit fails, train same predeclared expert once on planned rows, log reason.
stop: Gate failure => no ensemble; no added expert/rule/weight/seed. Leakage, raw-hash or preservation failure => abort. Rank format failure => skip rank only.
conclusion: Gate fail C. Otherwise A iff ensemble all protection guards; B iff any ensemble positive mean MacroF1 or class P/R/F1 change but guards fail; C otherwise. Compare best single expert separately; no automatic official model replacement.
tie: If multiple all-guard candidates, higher mean MacroF1, within1e-12 fewer zeros then higher minimum recall then hard_equal. No validation-optimized weights.
warning: 새 독립 Test 없음. 과거 Fold는 반복 사용된 개발 검증 자료이며 학습 구간이 겹침. Batch 9~10 신규 평가 없음. 공식 Model A 유지.
existing_model_choice_bias: Stage12 models have already been examined in prior research. Default seed/rule freezing does not erase historical selection bias.
